perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.desc: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Directly competing with Contingency Plan and having similar competition with Servant Leader is tough. Aisha’s Embrace separates itself by both offering different zoom levels, as well as a very compelling perk pool. Having triple tap and vorpal on a full auto scout just feels right. You could also try to use shoot to loot or focused fury depending on how you want to spec your scout. Aisha’s Embrace offers some really good PvE utility that Contingency Plan just doesn’t have room to compete with.". Recommended MW - Range.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Where Aisha’s Embrace does fall off is in the crucible. Which is weird considering it is a Trials of Osiris weapon. I think Contingency Plan wins out with access to kill clip, firmly planted and a lower zoom by comparison. You can try and make Aisha’s Embrace work with perpetual motion and multikill clip, but it won’t be as easy to use.". Recommended MW - Handling.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 14. PvE first-choice roll for end-game content. The Alacrity trait is surprisingly useful for solo Lost Sectors. Handling could do with some attention, and then for you can't go far wrong with Triple Tap and Frenzy. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod or damage-boosting (Minor, Adept Big Ones or Taken Spec) mod.
